basics.name: Morgan Achterberg
basics.label: Staff Software Engineer
basics.summary: Staff engineer with over fifteen years of experience building distributed data systems. Leads platform teams, turns unreliable pipelines into dependable products, and cares about efficient, well-tested code and clear documentation.

objective: Lead a platform team building reliable data infrastructure.

work.name: Northwind Data
work.summary: Tech lead for the ingestion platform.
highlights: Scaled ingestion to two million events per second by redesigning partitioning and backpressure across 40 Kafka topics
Led a platform team of eight engineers and set the technical roadmap for streaming, storage and query services
Cut cloud spend by 31% after profiling hot paths and moving cold data to tiered object storage
Introduced an incident review workflow that halved repeat outages within two quarters
Mentored five engineers to senior level through pairing, design reviews and a weekly reading group

work.name: Fabrikam Labs
highlights: Designed the multi-region storage layer serving 12 billion reads per day with 99.99% availability
Built an efficient change-data-capture pipeline from PostgreSQL to the analytics warehouse
Replaced a fragile cron-based scheduler with a fault-tolerant workflow engine written in Go
Defined service level objectives and on-call practices adopted by six product teams

work.name: Contoso Analytics
highlights: Shipped the first real-time dashboard product, used by 300 enterprise customers
Rewrote the query planner, making the slowest reports four times faster
Added end-to-end tracing with OpenTelemetry across 25 services
Ran a fluent, bilingual support rotation for Dutch and English customers

work.name: Tailspin Toys
highlights: Built payment and order services handling seasonal peaks of 50,000 orders per hour
Automated deployments with a continuous delivery pipeline, from weekly releases to several per day
Wrote integration tests that raised coverage of the checkout flow from 35% to 90%
Migrated file-based configuration to a central, versioned configuration service

work.name: Litware
highlights: Maintained the internal reporting tool and fixed long-standing performance issues
Built a CSV import that replaced hours of manual data entry each week
Documented the release process for a team of twelve developers
Mentored 40 students

publications.name: Backpressure in Practice
publications.summary: Patterns for flow control in streaming systems.

references.name: Avery Example
references.reference: Morgan raised the bar for every team they joined.
